name: TMXKIT Addons for Elementor
author: thememx

sections.description:
TMXKIT Addons for Elementor is a lightweight and performance-focused Elementor addon that helps you build beautiful WordPress websites using modern, customizable widgets.

The plugin is designed with clean code, fast performance, and an easy-to-use interface, making it suitable for freelancers, agencies, and website creators.

Included Widgets

  • Hero Slider
  • Advanced Heading
  • Advanced Button
  • Icon Box
  • Image Box
  • Counter
  • Pricing Table
  • Testimonial
  • Team Member
  • Call To Action
  • Progress Bar
  • FAQ Accordion
  • Tabs
  • Timeline
  • Image Gallery
  • Video Popup
  • Before / After Image
  • Flip Box
  • Nav Menu
  • Site Logo

Features

  • Lightweight & Fast
  • Fully Responsive
  • Clean & Modern Design
  • Elementor Native Controls
  • Typography Controls
  • Color Controls
  • Spacing Controls
  • Border & Border Radius
  • Box Shadow Controls
  • Unlimited Color Options
  • Developer Friendly
  • Works with Elementor Free
  • Compatible with Most WordPress Themes

License

TMXKIT Addons for Elementor is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tmxkit-addons-for-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Open Elementor editor and start using TMXKIT widgets.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and activated.

Does it work with Elementor Free?

Yes.

Is Elementor Pro required?

No. TMXKIT works with Elementor Free.

Is it compatible with any WordPress theme?

Yes. It works with most Elementor-compatible themes.

Is the plugin lightweight?

Yes. It is optimized for performance and fast loading.
